products.name: Tempus AI
products.note: Precision medicine AI; genomic data; clinical trial matching; genetic privacy (GINA)

reading.body:
Tempus is a public, for-profit company applying AI to precision medicine, with its single recorded product focused on genomic data analysis, clinical trial matching, and genetic privacy considerations under GINA.

The product sits entirely within Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, a domain where the binding constraints on capability are less often compute and power than they are data access, regulatory clearance, and patient privacy law. The GINA reference in the product note signals that genomic data carries specific legal protections, which shapes what the system can ingest and how outputs can be used commercially.

The data does not cover revenue, model architecture, infrastructure footprint, or compute spend, so no connection to power or building constraints can be drawn here. What it does establish is the category of work: matching patients to clinical trials using genomic data is a narrow, high-stakes application where the quality and legality of training data may matter more than raw scale.
